name: Berubari Union
short: Preamble not a part of the Constitution
held: The Preamble is not a part of the Constitution and confers no substantive power. The first half was reversed in Kesavananda Bharati, 1973.

name: Shankari Prasad
held: A constitutional amendment is made under constituent power, not legislative power, so Article 13 does not touch it. The First Amendment survived.

name: Sajjan Singh
held: The same answer as Shankari Prasad, but two judges recorded doubts.

name: Golaknath
held: Reversed, by 6:5: an amendment is law for the purposes of Article 13, so Parliament cannot abridge fundamental rights at all. Prospective effect only.

name: Kesavananda Bharati
short: Parliament may amend any part, but not the basic structure
held: Thirteen judges, eleven opinions, 7:6. The amending power under Article 368 is wide but cannot damage the basic structure; Golaknath overruled. The Preamble is a part of the Constitution and amendable.

name: Indira Nehru Gandhi
short: Free and fair elections is basic structure
held: Free and fair elections are part of the basic structure.

name: Minerva Mills
held: Clauses 4 and 5 of Article 368, inserted by the 42nd Amendment, struck down: a limited amending power is itself part of the basic structure, as is the balance between Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.

name: Waman Rao
short: Doctrine applies to laws after 24 April 1973
held: The basic structure doctrine applies to laws made after 24 April 1973.

name: S. R. Bommai
short: Federalism and secularism are basic structure
held: Federalism and secularism are part of the basic structure.

name: I. R. Coelho
short: Post-1973 Ninth Schedule laws face review
held: Laws placed in the Ninth Schedule after 24 April 1973 are open to judicial review.

name: NJAC judgment
short: Independence of the judiciary is basic structure
held: Independence of the judiciary is part of the basic structure.

name: Puttaswamy (Aadhaar)
held: TODO: what it held. The journal records only that Rojer Mathew, 2019, doubted whether it applied the Money Bill test correctly.

name: Rojer Mathew
short: Money Bill question referred to a larger bench
held: A five-judge bench doubted whether Puttaswamy (Aadhaar), 2018, had applied the Money Bill test correctly and referred the question to a larger bench.
